blocks.content:
State Executive – Articles 153–167
Governor – Appointed by President
CM – Real executive
Article 161 – Governor’s pardon
Article 213 – Ordinance
Article 356 – President’s Rule
Council responsible to Assembly

items: Article 213 empowers the Governor to promulgate Ordinances during legislative recess.
Article 356 pertains to the imposition of President's Rule in states.
Distinction between Constitutional/Appointed head (Governor) and Real executive (CM) is a frequent exam topic.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Articles 153–167 deal with the State Executive.
The Governor is appointed by the President.
The Chief Minister (CM) is the real executive head.
Article 161 grants pardoning powers to the Governor, while Article 213 covers Ordinances.
The Council of Ministers is collectively responsible to the Assembly.
